chapter.heading: 2 Peter 3
The Day of the Lord Will Come
chapter.v: I am stirring up your sincere mind by way of reminder,
the holy prophets and the commandment of the Lord and Savior through your apostles,
his coming? For ever since the fathers fell asleep, all things are continuing as they were from the beginning of creation.”
a thousand years as one day.
the heavenly bodies will be burned up and dissolved, and the earth and the works that are done on it will be exposed.
what sort of people ought you to be in lives of holiness and godliness,
the heavenly bodies will melt as they burn!
according to the wisdom given him,
as they do the other Scriptures.
take care that you are not carried away with the error of lawless people and lose your own stability.

footnotes.footnote: 3:10 Greek *found*; some manuscripts *will be burned up*
